modes.name: Shiyu Defense: Critical Node
sharedMechanics: In this stage, dealing DMG to enemies earns you DMG Score. Defeating a single normal/elite enemy will grant you an instance of Elimination Score.
In this stage, scores earned at different times will receive additional multiplier bonuses. The earlier in the challenge, the higher the multiplier. The total score cap (including bonus) is 50,000.

bosses.name: Metamorphosed - Avarus
mechanics: If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat.

bosses.name: Doppelganger - Starlight - Billy
mechanics: Agent's Ultimate and Chain Attack DMG increase by 40%.
When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and Daze recovery speed slows down by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Sacrifice - Heretic Jester
mechanics: Agent Ice DMG and Electric DMG increase by 30%.
After an Agent with Attack specialty uses an EX Special Attack, their CRIT DMG increases by 30% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

enemies.name: Autonomous Support Unit - Lightfoot Rover MK II

selectableBuffs.name: United Strength
selectableBuffs.description: If there are 2/3 Agents in the squad with Anomaly specialty, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 30/70 respectively, and Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt increases by 10%/25% respectively. · After inflicting an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Frost Reins
selectableBuffs.description: For Agents with Attack specialty, their ATK increases by 25%. When their Basic Attack, EX Special Attack, or Chain Attack hits an enemy, it ignores 30% of the target's Ice RES and Ether RES. · When an Agent hits a Stunned enemy, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 40% for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

selectableBuffs.name: Breakthrough
selectableBuffs.description: Rupture specialty Agent Sheer DMG increases by 15%, and reduces Miasma Shield 30% faster. · While in Ether Veil, Agent Ether DMG increases by 25%, and hitting an enemy makes its Stun DMG Multiplier increase by 25% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

bosses.name: Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant
mechanics: When an Agent inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the target enemy gains 1 stack of Blight Mark of the corresponding attribute, lasting 30s and stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers of same-attribute Blight Mark reset its duration.
For every stack of Blight Mark inflicted, the enemies take 8% more Attribute Anomaly DMG, and DMG taken by Corruptive Barrier increases by 8%.
When inflicting Impaired or Shutdown on an enemy, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60 pts, lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Suitable for Agents with Anomaly specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Ye Shiyuan the Thrall
mechanics: When Sobek and The Thrall alternate turns, The Thrall gains 1 stack of Contract and Self-Sacrifice. Contract and Self-Sacrifice can stack up to 3 times. Each stack of Contract increases All-Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES by 15%, each stack of Self-Sacrifice increases The Thrall's Stun DMG Multiplier by 10%. When The Thrall is Stunned, CRIT DMG taken increases by 50%.

When Agents inflict Weakened on Sobek and The Thrall, 1,500 Performance Points will be awarded. When an Agent eliminates Sobek, 2,000 Performance Points will be awarded. Up to a maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be earned.
Suitable for Agents with Stun specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Miasma Priest
mechanics: When the Miasma Priest switches phase, their Anomaly Buildup RES increases by 10% and CRIT DMG taken increases by 30%. This effect can stack up to 2 times and is cleared when Miasmic Shield breaks.
When an Agent successfully performs 3 Defensive Assists within 3 seconds, earn 1,000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5,000 Performance Points can be obtained.
Suitable for Agents with Rupture specialty.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 6000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 14000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 20000 points within the time limit

bosses.name: Rewritten - Sanguine Sweeper
mechanics: When an Agent lands Shutdown on an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 10%, Agents with Attack specialty gain 20% bonus ATK, 25% bonus PEN Ratio, and their Ice and Ether CRIT DMG increases by 60%. Upon triggering a special stagger, the whole squad's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40 pts and their Anomaly DMG increases by 30%.

Each successful counter and subsequent trigger of a special stagger against the Boss's attacks grants 1,000 Performance Points. During the Control Skill, each successful counter against the Boss's attacks grants 500 Performance Points. Performing a Shutdown on the Boss's Control Skill grants 1,500 Performance Points. Maximum obtainable Performance Points: 5,000.
objectives: 1 étoile — Reach 10,000 points within the time limit
2 étoiles — Reach 20,000 points within the time limit
3 étoiles — Reach 30,000 points within the time limit
